title: Norwegian Lamb Skewers with Italian Twist
description: A fusion of Norwegian lamb and Italian flavors, perfect for a summer evening. Marinate the lamb in Italian herbs and grill to perfection.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into bite-sized pieces
ingredients.notes: Tender cuts work best for skewers

instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb pieces, parsley, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
Thread lamb pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
If using breadcrumbs, sprinkle a pinch onto each lamb piece.
Brush skewers with olive oil on both sides.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until lamb reaches 63°C (145°F) for medium-rare.
Let skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
